48h_use: Prepare launch draft only; schedule or submit after public assets are stable
prepared_asset: Live site, tagline, maker comment, screenshots, sample, pricing, route method
go_condition: Site explains what it does in one line and has a usable page for visitors
do_not_do: Do not ask for artificial upvotes or launch before the value page is clear
signal_to_record: Referral visits, comments, sample views, payment clicks

48h_use: Prepare a Show HN draft only if the public site is something people can try
prepared_asset: Website scorer, route method, sample Route File, GitHub repo
go_condition: Visitors can try a tool or inspect a concrete artifact without signing in
do_not_do: Do not post a pure service advertisement or vague landing page
signal_to_record: HN referral visits, comments, technical objections

48h_use: Answer only where it directly solves a question and community rules allow it
prepared_asset: Route-selection explanation, no-guarantee scoring limits, first-traffic checklist
go_condition: The answer stands alone without needing the link
do_not_do: Do not use fake Q&A, automated posting, vote manipulation, or link dumping
signal_to_record: Helpful replies, referral clicks, repeated objections

48h_use: Prepare a build-in-public post focused on evidence gaps and what changed
prepared_asset: 48-hour sprint, public update log, sample artifact, pricing boundary
go_condition: Post gives useful lessons and asks for critique rather than pushing payment
do_not_do: Do not post only a sales link or unsupported revenue claims
signal_to_record: Replies, profile visits, sample views, critique themes

48h_use: Use the repo as the public artifact trail immediately
prepared_asset: README, route registry, data CSVs, reports, source-backed limits
go_condition: README lets a technical reader understand the project without private context
do_not_do: Do not publish private customer, payment, or account data
signal_to_record: Repository visits, stars, issues, source-link clicks

48h_use: Run after public pages and sample are stable
prepared_asset: Fit Review sample, route method, pricing, intake, no-guarantee disclaimer
go_condition: The recipient plausibly has an AI-capable offer packaging problem
do_not_do: Do not automate DMs or store personal identifiers in public repo
signal_to_record: Aggregate replies, objections, sample views, confirmed payment, usable intake
